## Provenance notes

### `balalaika`

- Training allowed: LEGAL REVIEW

### `common_voice_ru_17_hf_mirror`

- Source: Mozilla Common Voice via pinned public Hugging Face mirror
- URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/fixie-ai/common_voice_17_0
